## Purpose

Describe the requested outcome and why the change is needed.

## Previous state

Describe the authoritative state before this change.

## Changes

List the implementation/documentation changes in scope.

## Files and systems affected

Identify repository paths and any connected GoreeCloud systems affected.

## Validation

Provide exact commands, workflow runs, test results, and revision evidence.

## Security and privacy

State security/privacy impact, permission changes, data exposure changes, and secret handling. Use `None` only when verified.

## Dependencies

List dependency additions/upgrades/removals and validation performed.

## Limitations / blockers

State what remains unimplemented, unverified, blocked, or explicitly out of scope.

## Release impact

State lifecycle/release impact. Do not imply Release Candidate, Stable, or production acceptance without evidence.

## Rollback / recovery

Describe the rollback and recovery path.
